summary: Methylprednisolone is an intermediate-acting synthetic glucocorticoid with potent anti-inflammatory and immunosuppressant activity and minimal mineralocorticoid effect. Used across endocrine, rheumatic, allergic, dermatologic, hematologic, neoplastic, and inflammatory conditions. Dose is individualized to the lowest effective amount; chronic therapy must be tapered, never stopped abruptly, to avoid adrenal crisis.
indications: Endocrine: adrenocortical insufficiency, congenital adrenal hyperplasia, nonsuppurative thyroiditis, hypercalcemia of malignancy
Rheumatic: rheumatoid arthritis, acute gouty arthritis
GI disease: ulcerative colitis, Crohn disease

dosage.n: Individualize; taper to lowest effective dose

dosage.d: Methylprednisolone sodium succinate; dose per indication
Acetate ester depot; dose per site

admin: Oral: take with food to reduce GI upset
Give once-daily dose in the morning to mimic circadian rhythm and limit HPA suppression
IV succinate may be given by slow injection or infusion for acute use
Acetate ester is for IM or intra-articular depot injection only (not IV)
Taper gradually after prolonged therapy; do not discontinue abruptly
moa: Binds cytoplasmic glucocorticoid receptors, modulating gene transcription to suppress inflammatory and immune responses. Inhibits leukocyte migration, decreases cytokine and prostaglandin production, stabilizes lysosomal membranes, and reduces capillary permeability. Possesses minimal mineralocorticoid activity.
preg: Crosses placenta. Use only if benefit outweighs risk. Possible intrauterine growth restriction and neonatal adrenal suppression.
lact: Excreted in breast milk. Low doses generally compatible; monitor infant for growth and adrenal effects.
renal: No specific dose adjustment; use with caution.
hepatic: Use with caution in cirrhosis; effect may be enhanced.

major: Live vaccines - avoid at immunosuppressive doses
CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, clarithromycin) - raise corticosteroid levels
CYP3A4 inducers (rifampin, phenytoin) - lower corticosteroid levels
interactions.food: Take with food to reduce GI upset
interactions.diagnostics: Suppresses skin test reactions; alters thyroid function and nitroblue tetrazolium tests

counsel: Do not stop suddenly; taper as directed
Take calcium and vitamin D to protect bones
pearls: 4 mg methylprednisolone is approximately equivalent to 5 mg prednisone
About 5x the glucocorticoid potency of hydrocortisone
Morning dosing reduces HPA axis suppression
Taper required if used longer than ~3 weeks
missed: Take the same day when remembered; skip if near the next dose; do not double up. Never stop abruptly on chronic therapy.
overdose: Acute overdose is rarely life-threatening; chronic excess produces Cushingoid/iatrogenic effects. Provide supportive management and monitor electrolytes and glucose.
